method: Random sample of 160 cards per era from the 34 Pokémon sets ShopCardHub indexes (cards with a PSA 10 sold mark). For each card: median of its last 90 days of sales in each grade, counted only when the sale title names that PSA grade (TAG 10 rows titled TAG; raw = Ungraded rows with no grading company in the title); a grade needs at least 2 sales. The multiple is computed per card (PSA 10 median / other grade median), then we report the median multiple across cards and the middle half (25th–75th percentile). Lots, proxies, customs and reprints are dropped; WOTC sets are split by edition (1st Edition / Shadowless / Unlimited). Vintage = 1999–2003 WOTC sets; modern = 2019 onward. Grading fees, shipping and selling fees are not included.
source: eBay completed sales read on PriceCharting (graded tabs + Ungraded), titles checked for the grade and never stored
